---
name: Bug report
about: Something didn't work or looked wrong
labels: bug
---
**What happened?** (what you typed/clicked, what you expected, what you saw)

**Steps to reproduce** — ideally on a throwaway folder (`cargo run --example make_mock -p tidy-agent-runtime -- ~/TidyMock`). Please redact personal paths.

**Version / macOS / chip** (Tidy shows its version at the bottom of the window)

**Did any file change unexpectedly?** If yes, mark this as a *security/safety* report and include the History entry.
